text: Illustration. Another car, earlier in April
Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater.
observed: Samples 18.0 to 18.8 s. Same flooded street. The brown water climbs on the white car from about wheel-hub height to over the wheel arches and lower doors. A dark gray rounded shape at the right edge of the water slides out. Car occupies a small band at mid frame; caption sits just below the water; the lower third is plain sidewalk tiles. No hazard lamps visible yet.
